content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

Infrastructure sovereignty in digital commerce means that the customer owns everything after deployment, with no platform dependencies and no subscriptions. COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to give digital creators a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. This is not a workaround, but a base-layer infrastructure solution that empowers creators to take control of their digital commerce operations.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

COREMERCH's architecture is built on a stack of free and paid tools, including GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, Google Drive, and NOWPayments. Each component plays a crucial role in enabling the secure and reliable operation of the online store, from hosting and backend logic to order storage and file delivery. By combining these tools, COREMERCH creates a seamless and efficient digital commerce experience for creators and their customers.
Who This Is Built For and Why

COREMERCH is designed specifically for digital creators in restricted countries who have been excluded from using popular digital commerce platforms. These creators can now sell digital products such as ebooks, courses, and software without relying on platforms that may not support their location or provide adequate security. With COREMERCH, creators can take control of their digital commerce operations and build a sustainable business model.
COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a permanent structural alternative to popular digital commerce platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The Edger Commerce Stack ($197) is a pre-configured solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. This stack is deployed in 48 hours and includes 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end testing before handoff. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is a more basic solution that includes GitHub Pages, Apps Script, and NOWPayments. Both stacks provide a secure and reliable digital commerce experience for creators and their customers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

The storefront in a COREMERCH deployment is a static site hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. It costs nothing to host. It scales to any traffic level automatically. It cannot be taken down by a payment platform's compliance decision because the hosting and the payment layer are completely separate infrastructure. Your buyer experience is clean and professional — a product page, a crypto checkout with QR code generation and live price feeds, and an automatic delivery email within 30 seconds of payment. Every component runs under your own accounts. If COREMERCH closed tomorrow, every store deployed would continue running exactly as it does today. That is what infrastructure ownership means.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
With COREMERCH, creators can take control of their digital commerce operations and build a sustainable business model.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking for a solution to sell digital products without Gumroad, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a pre-configured solution that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. For more information on how to sell digital products without relying on popular digital commerce platforms, visit the shop URL at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to learn more about COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I know if my country is restricted by Stripe or PayPal?
You can check the official websites of Stripe and PayPal to see if they operate in your country. If they do not, you may be eligible to use COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure.
What happens if I'm suspended from PayPal?

A PayPal account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days with no appeal. This can be devastating for any business. With COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure, you can avoid relying on PayPal and take control of your digital commerce operations.
Is NOWPayments secure?

NOWPayments is a secure payment gateway that supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. It has a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements. This makes it an attractive option for creators who want to accept cryptocurrency payments without relying on traditional payment gateways.
Can I use COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure with my existing website?
Yes, you can use COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure with your existing website. The solution is designed to be flexible and adaptable to different website platforms and configurations.
How do I get started with COREMERCH's sovereign commerce infrastructure?

To get started, visit the shop URL at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html to purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) or the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97). Once deployed, you'll have a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership.
